title: Propose selected complex layer with recursive row and precision closure
body:
I propose an all-size construction for the selected R480/T16 complex layer with cost `O(V*d^(599/600))` on the stated spaced-axis/long-record domain. I compose the pending ordinary-interchange contract from PR2234 and compact monomial implementation from PR2250 with the selected caller, complete recursive row/work allocation and one exact Gaussian-dyadic precision grid.

The main proof applies the common-label argument twice: to the local word and to the global nine-stage controller. I retain all original idle phase deadlines, including 6,822 nonzero translations after fully hosted children. For recursive precision, I bound completed child endpoints and reserve one grid at the root; I perform no rounding at child returns. I separate logical live volume from the additional physical work slots in the recurrence.

Local evidence includes both 24,767-event local programs on 704 live columns, the 482-event caller, 69,120 hosted occurrences and 5,348,224 signed kernel coefficients. I reuse and attribute the selected scalar and chart/phase checkers. The new sequential Gaussian checks cover non-power-of-two outer rows, cancellation, normalization, and adversarial rounding/division controls. Exact row, height and two-engine moment checks support the written induction.

I passed the registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays. After strengthening the rounding witness to use a root precision of p=2, I reran the arithmetic checks in both modes and matched the retained receipt. Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-complex-layer-closure
```

Reviewers should start with `PROOF.md` sections 2–6, especially global frame tracking, original idle deadlines, whole owner packets, row reserve and child-return precision. I have not executed the complete orthogonal-cover payload, emitted a full transition table, rerun Lean, or completed the outer FFT/error/integer-packing transfer. The two predecessor contracts still need review. I leave the selected frontier unchanged and make no integer multiplication exponent claim.

I coordinated in [Discussion2253](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2253). I started from canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, and refreshed it before submission. The final text search covered 508 open PRs, 995 Discussions and 1,538 local records with complete remote pagination and no warnings; it excludes arbitrary code diffs.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`) prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. `NOTICE.md` and `SOURCES.json` retain the selected native Clifford/gauge44/T16 lineage, Lemma G/A contributors, Gareth Davidson's chart/phase audit, Douglas Colkitt's compact-control work, the OpenAI framework and commdata2338's parking boundary. I claim no independent human or new proof-assistant verification.
